services.name: 2 Hour Virginia Beach Family Scenic Tours
Inshore Fishing Trips
services.desc: Enjoy a memorable day aboard the "AFISHINADO", a Virginia Beach and Chesapeake Bay charter! 4, 6, or 8 Hour Options About There is trolling the Virginia Beach oceanfront for Blues, Spanish Mackerel, King Mackerel, and other seasonal fish, Drifting for Flounder, Red Drum, Croakers, Black Sea Bass and more. Then there is anchoring and chumming for Cobia which can get up to 100lbs here in Virginia Beach, Big Red Drum that put up a great fight for any angler, and SHARK! We have a lot of different Sharks that swim in the coastal waters surrounding Virginia Beach and the Chesapeake Bay All Ages • 4, 6, or 8 Hour Options • Up to 6 Guests

services.name: Near Shore Fishing Trips
services.desc: These are great trips to fill up your cooler after a long day on the water! 6 or 8 Hour Options About A Near shore adventure consists of a few more options like either fishing the Chesapeake Bay from the Bay Bridge Tunnel to the mouth of the Chesapeake Bay for species like Striped Bass (Rockfish), Flounder, Croaker, Spot, Red Drum, Cobia, Sheepshead, Spadefish and Shark. Another charter destination we head to is the Chesapeake Light Tower (14 miles from Rudee Inlet), where we fish for Black Sea Bass, Tautog, Sheepshead, Cobia, Flounder and Spadefish. Spadefish is a great fight pound All Ages • 6 or 8 Hour Options • Up to 6 Guests

services.name: Inlet Trips
services.desc: 3 Hours About Fishing for speckled trout, redfish, and flounder! What's Included Licensed Captain and First Mate Fishing Licenses Bait and Tackle Rods and Reels Ice and on board cooler for fish What to Bring Sunscreen ( no spray allowed) Lunch, Snacks and Drinks (Beer cans allowed but no bottles or hard liquor) It gets hot on the ocean so plenty of water is recommended. Rain Gear / Jacket for inclement weather Sunglasses -- polarized is best Camera Boat shoes or shoes with light colored, non-slip soles A cooler for your catch (you can leave this one in you car until we return) Sea All Ages • 3 Hours • Up to 6 Guests
